As the EU's new transparency requirements for AI-generated content officially take effect, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that allows channel administrators to label specific types of AI-generated content. Details below.

"Channel admins in your country must update channels using AI content with a label"

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that allows channel administrators to mark specific types of content as AI-generated.

References to this new feature can currently be found in the latest WhatsApp Android beta, but since the feature appears to be designed to meet regulatory requirements in specific countries, an iOS version is expected to launch, with the scope of availability to gradually expand.

According to the report, the new feature will follow the same process channel administrators currently use when publishing sponsored content:

WABetaInfo points out that not all AI-generated content needs to be labelled. As described in the current launch screen, AI content includes images, videos, or other media created or edited using AI tools.

In other words, admins do not appear to need to label AI-generated text. It remains unclear whether this option will be rolled out globally or only available in regions where labelling is legally required.
